notes.title: BONK THE GOBLIN! Released!
notes.content:
Do you love these little goblins but tire of just grabbing them?? 
Don't you wish you could BONK them instead?!

Then you should get Bonk The Goblins! 
Bonk The Goblins! has just launched today and is whackamole with goblins and microgames!

Microgames you ask?  Of course there are microgames, not every goblin can simply be clicked to be bonked! Some require you to spell a word, complete a maze, or wiped off the screen!

Please check out the page and leaving a review would be a MASSIVE help!

notes.title: FREE new stage coming next week! :)
notes.content:
Kia ora! 
A free new stage will be coming to Grab the Goblins! at the start of next week.

The stage is the Fireplace, and is the same size as the Desk, but with some much harder to find goblins!
To unlock the Fireplace you just need to finish the Desk.

When this launches the game will also be on sale! So it'll be a good time to invite some friends to check the game out.

Thanks for the support shown on Grab the Goblins! I have also launched my second game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688110/The_Wizard_Party/]The Wizard Party[/url] as well as begun planning my next few projects! I'd greatly appreciate if you check those out too!

I would like to add even more free stages to Grab the Goblins! However that'll depend on whether people enjoy this one! 

Thanks,
Jack // nobones

notes.title: THE WIZARD PARTY, my second game, is coming very soon!
notes.content:
THE WIZARD PARTY is a whimsical point and click adventure with physics based objects and hand animated characters!

I've put a lot of effort into this game and would really appreciate if you wishlisted and bought it when it comes out!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688110/The_Wizard_Party/]The store page is here![/url]

Wishlist and buy THE WIZARD PARTY!

Thanks,

notes.title: Sit Back and Relax with Grab the Goblins! + Secret
notes.content:
Kia ora!

The Steam Awards are underway. 
If you felt so inclined, you could nominate Grab The Goblins! for the Sit back and Relax award.

Grab The Goblins! was made as a way to chill out, click some little goblins and destress from your daily life. If it helped you do that then I am stoked! Feel free to nominate it for the award if you feel it deserves it. 

Also Grab The Goblins! is currently 15% off! I don't intend to discount it more than that so now is a great chance to grab it or buy a copy for a friend :)
More importantly though...

You can now wishlist my next game, THE WIZARD PARTY.
It is a whimsical adventure filled with absurd characters. I am so excited to share it!
Check it out and wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688110/The_Wizard_Party/?beta=0

Thanks everyone,
and more is on its way...

Jack // nobones

notes.title: Sneaky Goblin Quest + New Achievement!
notes.content:
After completing the 4 stages the Sneaky Goblin will now appear in the desk stage!
Upon finding them there they will sneak off to somewhere else in the game. Upon finding them in all of their locations you will get a new achievement!

Keep in mind the sneaky goblin won't appear in the time trials.

This should add a unique twist and a bit more fun for those looking for it in Grab The Goblins! instead of finding lots of goblins in one stage, the Sneaky Goblin is one goblin that could could be any stage (also maybe more than just the stages...)

In terms of new content, I'd like to add another stage into the game, but I'm a little burnt out at the moment so that may have to come later down the line.

Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far and it'd mean a lot to me if you could leave a review :) 

Jack // nobones

notes.title: Achievements are now in Grab The Goblins!
notes.content:
Kia ora! 

I've added nine achievements for you to hunt down in the game!
There is also one more coming soon that'll require hunting down a new unique goblin...

Leaving a positive review for the game helps immensely by the way! If we can get 10 then steam gives the game a boost in visibilty.

Thanks to those who have played and enjoyed so far :)

Jack // nobones

notes.title: The game is live! Please review it and share with your friends and dogs!
notes.content:
I'm really excited to have the game out there and in people's hands!  ːsteamhappyː

If you find any bugs feel free to reply here or email me at jackharnett99@gmail.com

Also if you could positively review the game that'd help out immensely! I'm really proud of what I have made and reviewing and sharing help other people see it and hopefully have some fun.

If there is at least a few people who enjoy the game then I'd love to add a free stage or two in the future, but for now I am nervously awaiting any bug reports. 

Happy goblin grabbing!

notes.title: More Juice, Polish and Bug fixes for the Demo!
notes.content:
[b]All the stages and content for the game are nearly done! [/b]
So I spent a bit of time today adding a bit of juice! We have some buttons that wiggle or spin and counters that bounce!

I also changed the way the HUD is set so it hopefully shouldn't run into issues on widescreen monitors like there was before. Not to mention some bug fixes for things people hadn't noticed yet and some icon updates.

I'm very excited to have everything done and in your hands so soon there will be an announcement of the release date and likely another patch for the demo as I refine things before the final release.

Thanks for reading!
